name: application-slug-input
title: Slug Input
description: Title field paired with a live URL-slug preview or editable field, so users can see and optionally override the URL that will be generated from their content's title.
useWhen: Letting users see the URL that will be generated from a title before publishing.
Allowing an override of the auto-generated slug for SEO or readability reasons.
Building a CMS, blog editor, or settings page where content needs a stable, editable URL segment.
avoidWhen: The URL is never shown or editable by the user — skip the extra UI entirely.
The slug is derived from an immutable identifier (e.g. a database id) rather than a title — a plain read-only field is simpler.
No slugify logic is available yet — wire one in before shipping; do not fake the transformation with a hardcoded example.
responsiveBehavior: The component has a fixed max width; the slug row truncates the prefix and value with an ellipsis on narrow containers rather than wrapping.
accessibility: The title and slug fields each carry a real, associated label.
The Edit trigger is a real button with visible text describing its action.
The URL prefix is plain text adjacent to the editable value, not baked into a single unlabeled string, so screen readers can distinguish the fixed and editable parts.

variants.title: Always-editable slug field
variants.description: Title field with an always-visible, always-editable URL slug field beneath it and help text explaining the auto-generation.
accessibility: The slug field's label and the adjacent URL prefix are both real text, not combined into a single opaque string.

variants.title: Always-editable slug field (Dark)
variants.description: Always-editable slug field pair adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field borders and help text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Read-only preview with Edit trigger
variants.description: Read-only slug preview with a separate Edit button, keeping the URL out of the way until the user explicitly wants to change it.
accessibility: The Edit button has visible text, not just an icon, so its purpose is clear without relying on the icon alone.

variants.title: Read-only preview with Edit trigger (Dark)
variants.description: Read-only slug preview with an Edit trigger, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Preview text and Edit button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
